quote: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
title: Arise, awake
description:
> Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.

Vivekananda kept this line from the Katha Upanishad close. It is not about hurry. It is a refusal to sit down halfway.

Get up. See the work. Stay with it until it is done.

quote: Strength is life, weakness is death.
title: Strength is life
description:
> Strength is life, weakness is death.

He did not mean force over other people. He meant the strength to stand, to think, and to serve without folding.

A life that will not try has already left the room.

quote: The world is the great gymnasium where we come to make ourselves strong.
title: The gymnasium
description:
> The world is the great gymnasium where we come to make ourselves strong.

Difficulty is not a detour. In this reading, it is the apparatus.

You do not get strong by avoiding the weight.

quote: They alone live who live for others, the rest are more dead than alive.
title: Live for others
description:
> They alone live who live for others, the rest are more dead than alive.

This is the hard edge of the teaching. A private win that never leaves the room is not yet a life.

## What it asks

- Do the work in front of you.
- Leave someone else more able than you found them.
- Do not confuse being busy with being alive.

The test is plain. After you pass through a place, is it better.

Hold that against the week you just had. Not the week you meant to have.
